class.name: WorldEnvironmentND
class.description: A [WorldEnvironmentND] provides a [SkyMaterialND] to ND rendering engines. If the current environment has no sky material, or if no [WorldEnvironmentND] is current, the background is treated as black. Only one [WorldEnvironmentND] can be current per [Viewport]. Unlike Godot's [WorldEnvironment] which extends [Node], [WorldEnvironmentND] extends [NodeND], which means it has an ND transform.

method.name: clear_current
method.description: Stops this environment from being current. If [param enable_next] is [code]true[/code], another [WorldEnvironmentND] in the same viewport may become current.

method.name: make_current
method.description: Makes this environment current for its viewport.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this is the current ND environment for its viewport.
The material used to draw the sky. Assign a [PlainSkyMaterialND] or custom [SkyMaterialND].
